rca of the issue: Original bug (iteration_21): EditClienteModal's initial useState formData omitted sky_servizi, so on modal open `(formData.sky_servizi || []).includes(sid)` returned false for every id (all boxes unchecked). Any subsequent save spread formData into backendData, overwriting persisted sky_servizi with the operator's newly-toggled subset (or empty). Fix (iteration_22 verified): added `sky_servizi: cliente?.sky_servizi || [],` at line 266 of EditClienteModal.jsx alongside other cliente-derived fields. Now formData is properly hydrated from the cliente prop on modal mount, checkboxes reflect the true state, and handleSubmit sends the full array (including untouched services).
